Session date: 4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023
[D3:6] Tim: Wow, sounds like a blast! I had an incredible time meeting with that fellow fan. You can really feel the love when you're surrounded by people who share the same passion. Does that happen with your sport too?
[D3:7] John: Definitely! Being surrounded by teammates who are equally passionate creates a strong bond. We push each other to be our best and the love for the game is infectious. It's like having a second family.

Session date: 4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023

Session date: 8:17 pm on 21 September, 2023
[D11:21] John: Thanks! I'm trying to figure out how to pick the right ones - any advice on that?
[D11:22] Tim: When picking endorsements, make sure they align with your values and brand. Look for a company that shares your desire to make a change and help others. It's important that the endorsement feels authentic to your followers.
[D11:23] John: Sounds like good advice! I was wondering if you have any book recommendations for my trip?

Session date: 10:04 am on 19 December, 2023

[D25:4] John: Cheers! Got some awesome hiking stuff and outdoor gear - all top-notch. The photoshoot went really well too. We did it in a gorgeous forest and the photographer got some epic shots of me doing my thing - it was amazing!

Session date: 3:37 pm on 16 December, 2023
